name: MarketTwits News
description: Paid real-time Russian and global market news from the MarketTwits Telegram channel (translated to English), plus Bank of Russia FX rates, MOEX quotes, Rosstat data, public Telegram channels, Wildberries/Ozon product information, price/news/FX alerts and a daily Russia market digest. Pay per request in USDC on Base via x402.

endpoints.description: Latest translated MarketTwits news (newest first)
High-importance news only (newest first)
Keyword search in translated news (newest first)
Keyword alert check: how many matching items in the last N hours
Short extractive English summary of the latest news on a keyword
Top 5 keywords/hashtags in high-importance news of the last N hours
Extractive English summary of news on a keyword from the last N hours
Is there new HIGH-importance news on a keyword in the last N hours?
Trending topics in high-importance news with change vs. the previous window
Incremental feed: items newer than the id you already have (cursor polling)
Top gainers/losers reported in the news ('#TICKER = ±X%')
News about one country (flag emoji + country keywords) with counts and top topics
Macro data and earnings vs. expectations: actual, expected, previous, surprise
Heuristic bullish/bearish tone of news on a keyword (lexicon, not a model)
Sectioned briefing: central banks, macro, energy, equities, crypto, geopolitics
Official Bank of Russia FX rates (RUB) with day-over-day change
Bank of Russia key rate: current level, since when, and recent changes
Moscow Exchange stock quote (delayed ~15 min): price, change, volume, bid/offer
MOEX index values (IMOEX, RTSI, sector indices) or the index catalogue
Top gainers and losers on the Moscow Exchange main board (TQBR), with market breadth
Russian retail fuel prices (AI-92/95/98, diesel) — Rosstat weekly averages
Latest posts of a public Telegram channel (text, date, views, link)
Search up to 5 public Telegram channels for a keyword
Wildberries / Ozon product card: title, price (RUB), rating, reviews, stock
Compare 2-5 Wildberries products: prices, cheapest, price spread, stock
Price-target check for one product: is the current price at or below target_price?
Wildberries price history: weekly CDN points + observed + live price, min/max/avg, 30-day change
Price-drop alert: is a Wildberries product at or below your target price?
Keyword alert: new HIGH-importance news since an id or time
FX alert: is the official CBR rate of a currency outside your min/max band?
Daily Russia market digest: key rate, USD/EUR/CNY, fuel prices, top news
